row.evidence: The pricing page lists "SSO & SCIM Connections" only under Complete (Get a quote), and the help centre says "SCIM is available on the Complete plan only."
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated). Plans are Fundamentals (starting at $7,500/year), Complete and Defense (both Get a quote); pricing is per company, not per user. June's Complete estimate (~$14,000-20,000/yr), Fundamentals range (~$7,500-12,000/yr) and the 1.8 multiplier had no first-party source and are dropped; only the $7,500 Fundamentals floor is published. SAML/OIDC SSO and SCIM are both Complete-only, each limited to a single IdP/directory provider. On Complete, SCIM may still need enabling by account management (help centre points to accountmanagement@secureframe.com). SCIM and SSO run through WorkOS; Okta uses a generic SCIM 2.0 app, Google Workspace SCIM connections exist, Microsoft Entra SCIM is 'on the roadmap'. Category: compliance automation (GRC).

auth.token_source: Company Settings > SCIM Settings > Add SCIM Connection (WorkOS-hosted setup)

endpoints.notes: Endpoints are hosted by WorkOS; Secureframe does not publish the SCIM base URL or endpoint list.

operations.notes: 'update' recorded true in row from 'User and user updates (e.g. active status) are pushed'; HTTP verbs are not documented.

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users are treated as terminated/offboarded personnel; the personnel record stays in Secureframe.

attributes.notes: Only group names are described (prefixed with the IdP name); matching to existing personnel uses first name, last name and email (c19).

limitations.text: SCIM limited to any single directory provider on Complete.
Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD SCIM provisioning not available (on the roadmap).
On Complete, the SCIM Settings tab may need to be enabled by account management.
Group sync is additive: groups missing from a sync no longer wipe membership.

auth.notes: Header 'Authorization: <API_KEY> <API_SECRET>'; only Super Admins can create keys. UK region base URL is https://api-uk.secureframe.com.

endpoints.purpose: List users (filters: active, email, employee_type, personnel_status, ...)
Update a user (active, employee_type, start/end date, in_audit_scope)
List user accounts (accounts from connected integrations)
Link a user to a user account

audit_log_api.notes: API requests are recorded in the console Audit Log; no audit-log endpoint appears in the API reference.

rate_limits.text: 500 requests per minute per IP address; max 100 records per page.

limitations.text: No POST /users endpoint in the API reference, although the help article says the API can add personnel and assign roles.

okta.notes: No Secureframe app in the OIN search; Secureframe tells customers to use Okta's generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token)' per WorkOS instructions. Okta SAML sign-in is supported.

entra.notes: Entra ID SAML supported; SCIM for Entra 'on the roadmap'. Gallery listing not checked.

google.notes: Help centre refers to a 'Google Workspace SCIM' connection; mechanism not documented.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin SAML is in the supported IdP list; SCIM via OneLogin not documented (Custom SCIM option exists).

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud SAML is in the supported IdP list; JumpCloud support page returned 403.

fallbacks.other_sync: Standard Okta, Google Workspace, Entra ID and HRIS integrations sync personnel data without SCIM
